shortDescription: Configures timezone on Cisco UCS Manager

options.name: admin_state
options.description: The admin_state setting The enabled admin_state indicates the timezone configuration is utilized by UCS Manager. The disabled admin_state indicates the timezone configuration is ignored by UCS Manager.

options.name: description
options.description: A user-defined description of the timezone. Enter up to 256 characters. You can use any characters or spaces except the following: ` (accent mark),  (backslash), ^ (carat), " (double quote), = (equal sign), > (greater than), < (less than), or ' (single quote).

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of Cisco UCS Manager. Modules can be used with the UCS Platform Emulator U(https://cs.co/ucspe)

options.name: password
options.description: Password for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used during connection (by default uses 443 for https and 80 for http connection).

options.name: proxy
options.description: If use_proxy is no, specfies proxy to be used for connection. e.g. 'http://proxy.xy.z:8080'

options.name: state
options.description: If C(absent), will unset timezone. If C(present), will set or update timezone.

options.name: timezone
options.description: The timezone name. Time zone names are from the L(tz database,https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones) The timezone name is case sensitive. The timezone name can be between 0 and 510 alphanumeric characters. You cannot use spaces or any special characters other than "-" (hyphen), "_" (underscore), "/" (backslash).

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), will not use the proxy as defined by system environment variable.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(no), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.
